title: Placed tool catalogue
what: The tools the host serves, read from each tools root folder and from the registry pointers, reread when either changes so a put or take shows from the next call; retired versions swept once no call holds them. Lives in host/src/placed.rs.

title: Grant lock
what: Beneath the agent, a tool that acts runs only where the sender holds the room relation it declares, and a job for another user only where that user holds its capabilities, asked of bmo-web. Lives in host/src/lock.rs.

title: Namespace serving
what: One namespace of tools as the MCP protocol serves it to a session: entries the record names in shown listed by name, the rest booked into the toolbook, each call checked by the grant lock. Lives in host/src/handler.rs and residency.rs.

title: Host HTTP refusals
what: The RFC 7807 problem details the host answers before a request reaches a tool, each with an urn:sumida:error code. Lives in host/src/error.rs.

title: Tool host
what: The mcp-host process: every namespace and the toolbook on the loopback port behind each session bearer token, and the control socket launchers issue tokens on. Lives in host/src/server.rs and main.rs.

title: Session records
what: The records sessions are served by, issued and revoked on the control socket, one owner-only file each named by its token hash and read back at start. Lives in host/src/records.rs.

title: Tool runner
what: How a placed tool is run: a process per call handed its call on standard input, or one MCP server per record, each in a clean environment with its own call-back socket and its shared helpers. Lives in host/src/running.rs.

title: Toolbook
what: The server every line is handed beside its namespaces, listing, describing and calling the tools a session holds that its namespaces do not list, by the same dispatch a direct call takes. Lives in host/src/toolbook.rs.
